name: Cubiboot New UI
author: DarthMotzkus
description_short: A customizable GameCube boot menu for launching games and homebrew from multiple storage devices.
description_long: Cubiboot New UI uses the native GameCube menu to present games and homebrew from ODE devices—including FlippyDrive, CUBE-ODE, and GC Loader—and SD card adapters such as SD2SP2 and SD Gecko, preserving the look and feel of the original console experience. It integrates with Swiss to launch selected titles.
